46-006.r: Rana Pratap Sagar Dam → on Chambal at Rawatbhata, Rajasthan; begun 1953, inaugurated 1970.

47-001.r: Tehri Dam → Bhagirathi (Bhilangana joins at old Tehri), Tehri Garhwal, Uttarakhand; variant answer 'Bhagirathi and Bhilangana'; for flood storage, hydropower, irrigation.

47-004.r: Tehri dam → on Bhagirathi, the source stream of the Ganga; when Bhagirathi is not an option, answer 'Ganga'.

47-005.r: Tehri Dam site → confluence of Bhagirathi and Bhilangana (point C on the map).

48-001.r: Tilaiya Dam → Barakar river, Koderma district, Jharkhand; completed 1953; about 366 m long; irrigation and hydroelectricity.

48-002.r: Maithon, Belpahari and Tilaiya dams → on Barakar, main tributary of Damodar (first phase of Damodar Valley project).
48-002.t: Don't confuse: these dams are on the Barakar, not the Damodar main stream.

48-003.r: Damodar → 'River of Sorrow' (Sorrow of Bengal): fast upper course, sluggish lower course → floods and silt; A and R true, R explains A.

48-004.r: Damodar Valley Corporation → established 1948 under the DVC Act (Act XIV of 1948).

48-005.r: First multipurpose river valley project of independent India → Damodar Valley Project (DVC, 7 July 1948; West Bengal and Bihar, now Jharkhand).

49-001.r: Ukai → Tapi; Jayakawadi → Godavari; Khadakwasla → Mutha (Pune); Mayurakshi → Mayurakshi river.
49-001.c: No code is fully right: Mayurakshi is on the Mayurakshi river, not the Ambi. Code (b) gets the other three right; UPPSC's initial key (a) wrongly put Khadakwasla on the Ambi.

49-002.r: Wrong pair: Tawa Project — Krishna; Tawa is on the Tawa River. Correct: Midanpur Canal → Kangsabati (Kasai); Mettur → Cauvery; Ukai → Tapi.

49-003.r: Hirakud Project → Odisha; Haldia Refinery → West Bengal; Tarapur Nuclear Station → Maharashtra; Kudremukh Hills → Karnataka.

49-004.r: New Sutlej dam in Himachal Pradesh → to check silt flowing into Bhakra dam (silt weakens the dam and shortens its life).

49-005.r: Chukha Dam → built by India with Bhutan on Wang Chu (Raidak); 40 m high; begun 1974; India funded it: 60% grant, 40% loan.

49-006.r: Bhakra → Satluj; Hirakud → Mahanadi; Idukki → Periyar; Nagarjuna Sagar → Krishna.

49-007.r: Telugu Ganga → joint project of Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka (book also lists Maharashtra); Krishna water for drinking in Chennai (Madras).

49-009.r: 'Temples of modern India' → Jawaharlal Nehru's name for multipurpose river valley projects.

49-010.r: Cauvery → Mettur; Krishna → Almatti; Narmada → Sardar Sarovar; Chambal → Gandhi Sagar.

49-011.r: Almatti Dam → River Krishna; multipurpose (canal irrigation and hydroelectricity).

49-012.r: Mettur → Tamil Nadu (Cauvery); Mayurakshi → West Bengal (barrage at Tilpara near Suri); Nagarjuna Sagar → Andhra Pradesh; Hirakud → Odisha.

49-013.r: Idukki → Periyar (Kerala, arch dam); Matatila → Betwa (UP-MP joint); Nagarjuna Sagar → Krishna; Pochampad → Godavari.

49-014.r: Shivsamudram → Cauvery; Nagarjuna Sagar → Krishna; Jayakwadi → Godavari (Maharashtra); Tehri → Bhagirathi.

49-015.r: All four true: Rihand → on Rihand (Son tributary); Hirakud → Mahanadi; Tungabhadra → Andhra Pradesh-Karnataka joint; Maithon → Barakar (Damodar tributary), built 1957.

49-016.r: Kalpong Hydro-Electric Project → first hydro project of Andaman and Nicobar Islands, on the Kalpong river.

49-017.r: Oldest hydropower station → Sidrapong near Darjeeling, West Bengal (1897); second → Shivasamudram on Cauvery, Karnataka (1902).

49-019.r: Farakka → West Bengal (Ganga); Ghataprabha → Karnataka; Hirakud → Odisha (Mahanadi); Kakrapar → Gujarat (Tapti).

49-020.r: Rihand → Uttar Pradesh (Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar, Sonbhadra); Ukai → Gujarat (Tapi); Hirakud → Odisha; Koyna → Maharashtra.

49-021.r: Wrong pair: Kolleru Lake — Krishna; Kolleru lies between Krishna and Godavari valleys (natural flood-balancing reservoir). Govind Sagar → Satluj; Ukai → Tapi; Wular → Jhelum.

49-022.r: Kalagarh Dam → Ramganga Dam on Ramganga river, Uttarakhand; 715 m long, 128 m high.

49-023.r: Wrong pair: Ramganga dam length 8258 m; real length 715 m (height 128 m). Correct: 198 MW; Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand; about 6 lakh ha irrigated.

49-024.r: Tawa project → Hoshangabad (now Narmadapuram), MP, on Tawa river; built 1958-1978; between Satpura National Park and Bori Sanctuary.

49-025.r: Pong Dam (Beas Dam) → Beas river, Himachal Pradesh; its Maharana Pratap Sagar lake is a bird sanctuary.

49-026.r: Meja Dam → Kothari river (Banas tributary), Bhilwara district, Rajasthan; mainly irrigation.

49-027.r: Tulbul navigation project → Jhelum, at mouth of Wular Lake, J&K; proposed 1984; Pakistan protested in 1987 under the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty.

49-029.r: Baglihar project → Chenab, Ramban district, Jammu & Kashmir; run-of-the-river; Pakistan raised it before the World Bank.

49-031.r: Wrong pairs: Pandoh Dam → Beas, not Ravi; Srisailam → Krishna, not Tungabhadra. Baglihar → Chenab is correct (answer 2 and 3).

49-032.r: All correct: Damanganga → Gujarat (Valsad, Madhuban Dam); Girna → Maharashtra (Nashik); Pamba → Kerala (Pathanamthitta).

49-033.r: Tapovan and Vishnugarh hydro projects → Dhauliganga river, Chamoli district, Uttarakhand.

49-034.r: Mahakali Treaty (February 1996) → India and Nepal; Mahakali (Sharda) water: Sharda Barrage, Tanakpur Barrage, Pancheshwar Project.

49-035.r: Wrong pair: Rana Pratap Sagar — M.P.; it is at Rawatbhata, Rajasthan (MP has Gandhi Sagar). Kalpakkam → TN, Narora → UP, Tarapore → Maharashtra.

49-036.r: Kalpasar Project → Gujarat; dam across the Gulf of Khambhat for tidal power and a huge freshwater reservoir.

49-037.r: Wrong pair: Chambal Project — Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana; Chambal is Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh. Beas → Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana; Mahi Bajaj Sagar → Gujarat, Rajasthan.

49-038.r: Baira Siul project → Siul river (Ravi tributary), Chamba district, Himachal Pradesh.

49-039.r: Wrong pair: Sivasamudram — Kerala; it is in Karnataka. Jawahar Sagar → Rajasthan; Nagarjuna Sagar → Andhra Pradesh/Telangana; Gandhi Sagar → Madhya Pradesh.

49-040.r: Wrong pair: Nagarjuna Sagar — Godavari; it is on the Krishna. Nangal → Satluj; Sardar Sarovar → Narmada; Hirakud → Mahanadi.

49-041.r: Teesta Low Dam Projects III and IV → West Bengal; earlier Teesta projects I and II → Sikkim (variant answer: Sikkim).

49-043.r: Rihand project → Son (Rihand is its tributary); Rani Laxmibai Dam → Betwa; Tehri → Bhagirathi; Ramganga Project → Ramganga.

49-044.r: Rani Laxmibai Dam Project → Rajghat Dam on the Betwa, Lalitpur, Uttar Pradesh.

49-045.r: Dulhasti → 390 MW hydro plant on Chenab, Kishtwar district, Jammu & Kashmir.

49-046.r: Wrong pair: Nagarjuna Sagar — Kaveri; it is on the Krishna. Dulhasti → Chenab; Indira Gandhi Canal → Sutlej; Ukai → Tapti.
49-046.h: Nagarjuna Sagar = Krishna in every question.
